title: How Bryan Johnson makes his daily anti-aging "Super Veggie" lunch
summary: Bryan shares the exact recipe and cooking method for Super Veggie, the meal he eats every day. It combines black lentils, cruciferous vegetables, mushrooms and spices, cooked at low temperature with high humidity and acidity to limit AGEs and ALEs.

principles.text: Cook with low temperature, high humidity, high acidity and high antioxidants to minimize AGEs and ALEs.
principles.quote: Cooked via low temperature, high humidity, high acidity, high antioxidant cooking methods to minimize formation of Advanced Glycation End-products (AGEs) and Advanced Lipid Peroxidation End-products (ALEs).

principles.text: Boil or steam the vegetables until tender (7-9 min) rather than using high-heat cooking.
principles.quote: Boil until tender (7-9 min). Steaming is also acceptable.

principles.text: Base the meal on black lentils, broccoli, cauliflower and shiitake or maitake mushrooms, with garlic and ginger.
principles.quote: Black lentils, 45 grams dry, ~150 grams cooked

principles.text: Finish with extra virgin olive oil, hemp seeds, cumin, apple cider vinegar and lime.
principles.quote: After prep, drizzle 1 Tbsp of Extra Virgin Olive Oil

principles.text: Season with NuSalt (potassium chloride) instead of regular salt.
principles.quote: I season it with NuSalt (potassium chloride).

principles.text: Eat the same meal daily and find it delicious; expect an adaptation period when starting.
principles.quote: When starting, sometimes there is a period of adaptation and some want to play with the recipe and texture.
